headlines.text: It was 2025 when Jon Moxley vs. Powerhouse Hobbs went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.69. Jon Moxley was chasing gold for the 20th time. Moxley retained the AEW World Title over Hobbs, biting his ear bloody before the Death Riders and interference from Marina Shafir helped him lock in the Bulldog Choke for the submission win.
On a Wednesday in 2020, back when it was Diamond Dallas Page's first night in AEW, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.22.

That Wednesday in 2025, Megan Bayne kicked off their AEW journey in a Casino Gauntlet match against Toni Storm vs. Harley Cameron vs. Jamie Hayter vs. Julia Hart vs. Kris Statlander vs. Willow Nightingale, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.64.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, AEW welcomed MVP for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.72.
It was 2020 when PAC vs. Darby Allin closed out Dynamite, rated 7.84 ? a well-worked match, part of the special Bash at the Beach '20 - Night 1 card.

2025 brought us this moment: Kenny Omega chalked up their 100th recorded AEW match ? a major milestone, facing Kenny Omega vs. Brian Cage, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 7.12 ? a strong outing in a hard-fought men's division clash, part of the special Maximum Carnage '25 - Night 1 card.
